description: Navigate to the 'Purchase Orders' tab in Manager.io (Northwind Traders). Locate Purchase Order #PO-8842 issued to 'Exotic Liquids'. A partial shipment has arrived containing only 15 units of 'Boston Crab Meat' (ordered quantity was 40). Create a Goods Receipt for this Purchase Order and ensure the quantity is updated to exactly 15 to reflect the actual delivery. Save the Goods Receipt.
